### Understanding Where True Restoration Begins
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-dec-6-2010-11642205.html
Passage: Psalm 80:7
Points:
- Modern society often claims religious identity while lacking genuine godliness.
- Believers risk becoming comfortable with spiritual darkness instead of shining the light of Christ.
- Spiritual restoration in a nation must begin with individual believers rather than others.
- Christians must ask God to initiate lasting revival first in their own hearts.

### "Oops! Advent Began Last Sunday?" - Crosswalk the Devotional - Nov. 30, 2011
Author: Alex Crain
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/oops-advent-began-last-sunday-crosswalk-the-devotional-nov-30-2011.html
Passage: Psalm 80:2
Points:
- Missing the opening Sunday of Advent should not discourage anyone from participating.
- The season provides an opportunity to slow down and ponder why humanity needs a Savior.
- Setting aside time for God's Word helps cultivate enduring spiritual truths in families.
- Believers can ask God to restore their appetite for Scripture and revive their hearts.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 6/29
Author: Barbour Publishing
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-6-or-29-552416.html
Passage: Psalm 80:13
Points:
- Just as woodland animals blindly trample a beloved garden, people often destroy God's creation.
- Humanity has been given the unique capacity to appreciate the splendor of the natural world.
- Believers are called to value, defend, and care for the earth rather than neglect it.
- Prayer asks God to keep us from thoughtless living and open our eyes to His works.
